evidence.note: MTLD3D12Device::CheckFeatureSupport is the current runtime implementation.
Phase 4 will prove these reports without launching a game.

D3D12_FEATURE_D3D12_OPTIONS.risk: Over-reporting can push games into unimplemented render paths.

D3D12_FEATURE_D3D12_OPTIONS1.risk: WaveOps reporting must remain coupled to the 32-lane dispatch/readback corpus.

D3D12_METAL_RAYTRACING_HARDWARE.risk: Metal hardware support is only a prerequisite; DXR tier must remain unreported until acceleration structures, state objects, shader tables, synchronization, and DispatchRays pass behavior gates.

D3D12_FEATURE_D3D12_OPTIONS7.risk: The AS/MS payload, stage-specific root-CBV/raw-SRV, and direct/indirect DispatchMesh readback gate does not yet prove texture/sampler/UAV resources, mixed render state, statistics, render-target arrays, or broad shader coverage required to report mesh tier 1.

D3D12_FEATURE_D3D12_OPTIONS11.risk: Should stay conservative unless descriptor-heap atomic64 is implemented.

D3D12_FEATURE_D3D12_OPTIONS9.risk: Should stay conservative unless atomic64 is actually implemented.

D3D12_FEATURE_LEVEL_12_2_TARGET.risk: Raising the central maximum before every FL12_2 behavior gate passes would recreate false-success device creation.

D3D12_FEATURE_FEATURE_LEVELS.risk: UE5 may reject the adapter if this disagrees with shader model or options queries.

D3D12_FEATURE_SHADER_MODEL.risk: SM 6.6 must stay unreported until the SM 6.6 compiler, descriptor, resource, sampler, 64-bit, atomic, barrier, and runtime corpus is reportable.

D3D12_SYNTHETIC_SHADER_CORPUS.risk: Game captures must remain diagnostic; shader support claims require synthetic corpus coverage.

purpose: Keep D3D12 feature reports aligned with executable implementation reality.
